reuse.why: Routes the rule through the existing isCategoryFilled selection, but hand-writes a #fixed regex instead of using the shared tag parser (extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts), with different delimiter semantics.

duplication.why: The same notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes column is pasted into three separate category queries, and tag detection re-implements shared tag parsing.

placement.why: The exclusion sits in the month-fill selection predicate in budget/actions.ts where hidden/template exclusions already live; only the tag matching belongs in shared/tags.

scope.why: Only the fill selection, its feeding queries and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One predicate owns the rule, but the bespoke regex can drift from how tags are parsed elsewhere and three queries must stay in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts FIXED_GROUP_TAG/isFixedGroup re-implements tag detection instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: isFixedGroup's regex is a reshaped version of the shared tag-matching logic in shared/tags.ts (different delimiter rules).

one_place.where: isCategoryFilled in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getAverageFillCategories (all average fills).
